title: 주변 분포를 보존하는 Flow Matching과 구역 동시 부족 예측

plan.question: Can a conditional FM dependence template improve regional joint shortage forecasts while keeping each station marginal ensemble exactly unchanged?
plan.hypothesis: Under a common frozen marginal net-flow ensemble, FM+rank coupling reduces September regional-zero-fraction CRPS by >1% against independence, a historical-selected Gaussian copula and current-state persistence, with both 3/7-day lower bounds >1%. This is a proposed criterion, not an observed benefit.

prior_art.title: Schefzik, Thorarinsdottir & Gneiting, Ensemble Copula Coupling
prior_art.verified_scope: 원문§3.1/§4.2–4.3, reordering and unchanged marginal samples; ECC-R definitions.
prior_art.difference_to_test: Use a learned conditional FM rank template for Tashu signed net flows; the rank-preservation result is not evidence of forecast/operational benefit.

prior_art.title: Salinas et al., Low-rank Gaussian Copula Processes, NeurIPS2019
prior_art.verified_scope: Original abstract and §2–4 low-rank-plus-diagonal covariance and marginal transforms.
prior_art.difference_to_test: Mandatory conditional Gaussian dependence control; not a full reproduction of the original RNN model.

prior_art.title: Scheuerer & Hamill, Variogram-Based Proper Scoring Rules
prior_art.verified_scope: Original abstract and §2 equations3–4 and weighting discussion; dependence sensitivity and energy-score limitations.
prior_art.difference_to_test: Use VS0.5 with historical-only pair/scale definitions, alongside region aggregate CRPS and joint-zero Brier; no one score certifies a full joint law.

prior_art.title: Kollovieh et al., Flow Matching with Gaussian Process Priors, ICLR2025
prior_art.verified_scope: Original abstract/problem statement and distinction of flow-time vs physical series time; univariate forecasting setting.
prior_art.difference_to_test: Motivates examining structured conditional priors. Our graph/station covariance is a proposal, not a demonstrated multivariate extension of that paper.

prior_art.title: Wei & Pearson, Flow Matching for Count Data, arXiv2026 preprint
prior_art.verified_scope: Original abstract and §2.1–2.3 local birth/death rates, count bridge and approximate generation.
prior_art.difference_to_test: Alternative for a future marginal-count-model hypothesis. Its latent birth/death path is not a measured bicycle rebalancing or physical-time simulator.

prior_art.title: Lipman et al., Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
prior_art.verified_scope: Original §3 conditional vector-field regression, also verified in H13.
prior_art.difference_to_test: Conditional whole-supported-cohort rank templates, not separate station-wise rental/return heads.

data.observed_truth: Historical completed 10min net-flow vectors for learning/internal selection; future September API displayed stock for external joint-zero evaluation.
not_observed: Operator actions/costs and counterfactual relocation outcomes

evaluation.design: Design proposal: docs/H-0014-dependence-flow-design.md; SHA256=06794993c16d488187632c19e0bac3611c9e530689c12ab6c408cdcdd175e52b. Whole-supported-cohort conditional FM rank template, common marginal net-flow samples, ECC reordering, fixed regional-zero-risk evaluation. Not preregistered: complete tensor/support/region/compute audit and pin executable config before freeze.
baselines: Conditional low-rank Gaussian template + same rank coupling
FM template with independent per-station member shuffles
evaluation.success_rule: Proposed: exact marginal multiset invariant + historical validation gate + >=16 scored fixed regions/10000 region-issues/10 days/1900 valid bootstrap replicates; worst-control gain and 3/7-day95% lower bounds all >1%.
evaluation.failure_rule: With sufficiency, both upper bounds<=1% means not_supported; otherwise inconclusive. Invariant failure blocks release. Historical gate failure stops before API with external result unexecuted; preserve failure.
evaluation.exclusion_rule: Freeze historical support/region partition before API. Forecast complete current-supported regions without future information. Future missingness/timing applied only to score, never change region composition or forecast RNG. No error-based exclusions.
evaluation.uncertainty_plan: City-synchronized3/7calendar-day blocks,2000PCG64 replicates seed20261104; fixed equal-region weighting; exposed September not independent; fitted-model/selection/MC uncertainty excluded. Ordinary empirical-distribution CRPS/energy, not IID fair formulas after rank coupling.
evaluation.seed_plan: Proposed model seeds11/29; M128; shared marginal draws and documented distinct noise/tie/shuffle streams, one model-seed per entire scenario. Exact optimizer/budget/checkpoint schedule and derived hashes must pass historical-only audit and be frozen before any fit/comparison.

required_before_freeze: Executable config and checkpoint budget on dislab
Pin input/code hashes and publish frozen plan before learning
